item.title: Four arrests in St Ann’s murder investigation
item.description: Four people have been arrested as detectives continue their investigation into the murder of a 20-year-old man. Police were called to Abbotsford Drive, St Ann’s, Nottingham, around 12.50pm on 10 November last year after Marley Gascoine was found seriously injured. item.description: A statement on Lincolnshire County Council’s vision for the future appears to be heavily copied from one by Nottingham City Council.
